zh: 单词之间可能隔着多个空格，文本也可能为空；先把每个单词正确切出来，再逐个判断。
按空白切分得到单词，比较每个单词的首字母和末字母，比较前统一转成小写。
遍历切分结果，统计“小写首字母等于小写末字母”的单词个数（只有一个字母的单词也算）；空文本没有单词，输出 0。
en: Words may be separated by several spaces and the text may be empty; split out each word correctly first, then check them one by one.
Split on whitespace to get the words and compare each word's first and last letters after converting both to lowercase.
Count the words whose lowercase first letter equals their lowercase last letter (a one-letter word qualifies); empty text has no words, so the answer is 0.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Split the text into words on whitespace and compare each word's first and last letters after lowercasing.

## Proof of correctness

Each token produced by the split corresponds to exactly one word; a case-insensitive comparison of its first and last characters is equivalent to the statement, and summing the truth values gives the required count.

## Complexity

O(L) time and O(L) space (for storing the tokens).

## Source and additions

https://oamaster.com/docs/companies/koddi#1-count-words-starting-and-ending-with-same-letter; the statement, the case rule, and the empty-string example are explicit; this site adds the line-based input protocol.
